is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper focuses exclusively on bioassay-based resistance intensity measurements (WHO tube, CDC bottle, cone bioassays) and does not report any genotyping of insecticide-resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data (RR/RS/SS counts or frequencies) are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Field-caught mosquitoes were collected from Tiefora, Burkina Faso.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study comparing bioassay methodologies.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the collection site as Tiefora, Banfora District, Burkina Faso.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field collections were performed between May and September 2014.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new bioassay experiments on field-collected mosquitoes.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This study compares different bioassay methodologies (WHO susceptibility, CDC bottle, I-RDT, and cone bioassays) to measure insecticide resistance intensity in laboratory strains and a field population of Anopheles gambiae s.l. from Burkina Faso. The paper does not perform or report any molecular genotyping of resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper does not report any genotyping of insecticide-resistance markers.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No genotype data are reported.
